official_sources.title: Good Display FAQ-1 General Questions
findings: GDEH partial refresh requires background preparation before partial refresh.
Partial refresh process is old data, then new data, then update.
After five partial refreshes, Good Display recommends a full black-and-white refresh and a longer interval to reduce ghosting.
Partial refresh is best above 20 degrees C; below 20 degrees C the refresh time must increase and below 0 degrees C partial refresh is unsupported.

official_sources.title: Good Display update-mode guidance
findings: Repeated partial or fast updates can leave prior content visible as ghosting.
A full update removes ghosting and Good Display recommends one after five or six partial or fast updates.

official_sources.title: Good Display GDEY0154D67 product and download page
findings: The official product identifies GDEY0154D67 as 200x200, SSD1681 and supporting partial refresh.
The official site separately publishes GDEY0154D67 STM32 sample code and an SSD1681 driver document.

official_sources.title: Good Display GDEY0154D67-FT01 product page
findings: The related 200x200 SSD1681 product lists partial refresh at 0.3 s and fast refresh at 1.5 s.

allowed_single_variable_diagnostic.baseline: retain supplier source 0x24 then 0x26 full 5000-byte base map and 0xF7 update
allowed_single_variable_diagnostic.partial: retain source reset, 0x3C=0x80, window/counter order, 0xFF, 0x20 and BUSY; write prior changed region to 0x26 then current changed region to 0x24
forbidden: LUT_DATA change or a custom LUT
VCOM, rail, temperature or update-control-byte tuning
claiming that the external GDEY source proves the current panel/FPC identity

decision_tree.old_new_ram_ab_removes_or_materially_red: retain only as a separately reviewed, bounded diagnostic candidate; no production promotion without panel identity and repeated physical evidence
decision_tree.old_new_ram_ab_still_has_material_residu: the official available remedy is a full black/white clean after five partial updates; compare that visible interruption separately, or request a panel-bound partial waveform/recovery source from Good Display
decision_tree.full_clean_is_visually_unacceptable: NO_GO for OLED-like continuous e-paper expression motion with the current source set

identity_boundary: The official web source is exact for the GDEY0154D67 family but the observed panel/FPC marking 0154BN-D67-D2 is not yet documentary proof of exact identity; use only production-off current-room evidence.
